fun_facts: In a 2023 UCLA game against Boise State, J. Michael Sturdivant caught four passes for 142 yards and a touchdown.
J. Michael Sturdivant finished his college career with 150 catches, 2,073 receiving yards, and 16 touchdowns.
J. Michael Sturdivant ran the 40-yard dash in 4.40 seconds at the 2026 NFL Scouting Combine.
In a 2026 Packers preseason game against the Cardinals, J. Michael Sturdivant caught six passes for 112 yards and a touchdown.
J. Michael Sturdivant played college football at California, UCLA, and Florida.
